name: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: Chilled Minced Beef, spaghetti, tomato sauce, onion, garlic, olive oil, salt, pepper
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add finely chopped onion and minced garlic; sauté until translucent. Add the minced beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon. Stir in tomato sauce, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 15‑20 minutes. Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package instructions and drain. Combine the sauce with the cooked spaghetti and serve hot.

name: Beef Chili
ingredients: Chilled Minced Beef, kidney beans, canned diced tomatoes, onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin, olive oil, salt
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add diced onion and minced garlic; sauté until softened. Add the minced beef and brown it thoroughly. Stir in chili powder, cumin, salt, canned diced tomatoes, and drained kidney beans. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30‑40 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve the chili hot, optionally with rice or crusty bread.

name: Beef Tacos
ingredients: Chilled Minced Beef, taco shells, lettuce, cheddar cheese, salsa, onion, garlic, cumin, olive oil, salt, pepper
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium‑high heat. Add finely chopped onion and minced garlic; cook until fragrant. Add the minced beef, season with cumin, salt, and pepper, and cook until fully browned. Warm taco shells according to package instructions. Fill each shell with the cooked beef, shredded lettuce, grated cheddar cheese, and a spoonful of salsa.
